snippets.snippet_text: "I have been a Domestika customer for 3 years with 30+ courses in my library. I thought they were good. Clearly not. Like everyone else, I got an ad for £0.99 courses, bought it. No mention of a free trial or annual subscription at all... As a customer, my trust has been utterly betrayed. The cracks in their business practices had been showing for years with the way they treated their teachers. But this is a new low."
